dirtyDetail: Unsaved document changes will be lost. Chat drafts will be kept for the next launch.
runningDetail: Quitting DSH will stop active tasks. Saved chats can be continued the next time you open DSH.
dirtyRunningDetail: Unsaved document changes will be lost and active tasks will stop. Chat drafts and saved chats will be kept.
reloadDirtyDetail: Reloading will discard unsaved document changes. Chat drafts will be kept. Model chats, terminals, background commands, and automations will continue running.
reloadFlushFailedDetail: The interface did not finish saving. Cancel and retry, or explicitly choose to discard changes and reload. Background tasks will continue running.
flushFailedTitle: Current state has not been saved
flushFailedDetail: The interface did not finish saving. Cancel and retry, or explicitly choose to quit anyway.
shutdownFailedTitle: Tasks have not finished shutting down
shutdownFailedDetail: DSH is still closing its own execution engine. You can keep waiting or retry cleanup, or force this DSH app to quit.
startupFailedDetail: Open DSH again. If the problem continues, check this app's data folder and installation files.
rendererFailedDetail: Automatic interface recovery failed repeatedly and has paused. Background tasks remain managed by DSH. Reload to recover saved chats and drafts; changes that had not reached storage before the crash may be missing.
aboutDetail:
Independent desktop client · Codex execution engine · OpenCode Go · DeepSeek
Interface data is stored separately from the official Codex app.
